resources.string: The app does not read books itself: it builds the library and opens a book in your reader. The shelf, search and filters work fully offline.

Choose the folder with books itself (for example «Books»), not the storage root: on Android 11+ the system does not give the app the storage root, the SD card root or the «Download» folder. If the books are in «Download», move them to another folder or enable «All files access» in the full build.
Access to a folder is lost if the folder is moved or deleted. Then the shelf will ask to choose the folder again, and the books already found stay in the library.
No folders added yet — there is nothing to build the library from without a source.
